data.content: What is the temporal coverage (min/max year) of the monitoring data stored on MEASURED_AT relationships?

args.query: What is the temporal coverage of the monitoring data: report the minimum and maximum year recorded on MEASURED_AT relationships.

data.content:
The results comprise 1 rows:
            
            <data>
            {"min_year":{"0":1998},"max_year":{"0":2020}}
            </data>
            
            Provide the user with a Markdown formatted table of the data and a textual summary.
            <summary>
            {"min_year":{"count":1.0,"mean":1998.0,"std":null,"min":1998.0,"25%":1998.0,"50%":1998.0,"75%":1998.0,"max":1998.0},"max_year":{"count":1.0,"mean":2020.0,"std":null,"min":2020.0,"25%":2020.0,"50%":2020.0,"75%":2020.0,"max":2020.0}}
            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
WHERE r.year IS NOT NULL
RETURN min(r.year) AS min_year, max(r.year) AS max_year

            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding
            the full Neo4j graph database where the user can access the complete result with the cypher query.
data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
The monitoring data on MEASURED_AT relationships spans from 1998 to 2020.

To reproduce this result, run the following Cypher query:
MATCH (:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
WHERE r.year IS NOT NULL
RETURN min(r.year) AS min_year, max(r.year) AS max_year

Access the full Neo4j graph database (Docker container) here: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
